summary: AIFU Inc., a Shenzhen-based insurance services foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting completion on October 12, 2026 of a previously disclosed private placement. The company issued 45,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$3.00 per share for approximately $135.0 million gross proceeds, plus warrants for up to 90,000,000 Class A shares, half struck at 200% and half at 250% of the purchase price. Post-closing capitalization is 61,175,748 shares: 50,925,748 Class A and 10,250,000 Class B. Proceeds fund business plans and working capital. Watch warrant dilution and the Class B voting overhang.
